nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances; written directly with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; mutated unchecked in transferFrom.
Private owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; gates delegate, Rates, Dismiss and batchSend.
Address whitelisted in ensure(); freely overwritable through the unrestricted AddLiquidity function.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale user supplied supply/sale values.
Total token supply assigned once in the constructor.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Per-address whitelist flag toggled by Rates() and read in ensure().
Minimum sale amount configured by Dismiss() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale amount configured by Dismiss() and enforced in condition().
Maximum allowed sales per address configured by Dismiss() and read in condition().
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance/allowance checks, ensure() gating and raw unchecked balance mutations.
Public payable approve that stores allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without any checks.
Internal view whitelist check using owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and pairFor-derived pair; falls back to condition().
Internal view gate enforcing _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and per-address _onSaleNum limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall into a caller supplied address and calldata.
Privileged function that directly overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals and whitelists spender.
Owner-only function configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked arithmetic and duplicate Transfer events.
Unrestricted function that overwrites the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address from factory and token addresses.
Payable constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender and granting infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
External caller used as sender, owner, spender and as the sole authorization check in privileged functions.
Raw a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate() executes arbitrary untrusted bytecode in the token's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value / balanceOf[_to] += _value and allowance subtraction performed without SafeMath.
Rates() assigns balanceOf[spender] directly, allowing arbitrary balance inflation by the owner or a hardcoded address.
batchSend multiplies/accumulates balances unchecked and loops over an attacker-influenced array length.
AddLiquidity() sets tradeAddress, a whitelist bypass primitive, with no access control.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution and its arguments to transferFrom().
_to of transfer() becomes the _to argument of transferFrom().
_value of transfer() becomes the _value argument of transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as _from in transferFrom(), controlling the allowance branch.
_from is passed into ensure() for whitelist validation.
_to is passed into ensure() for whitelist validation.
_value is passed into ensure() and ultimately to condition().
ensure() passes _from to condition() to look up _onSaleNum.
ensure() passes _value to condition() for min/max sale checks.
ensure() conditionally calls condition() via require() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() reads the constant UNI router address for whitelisting.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the liquidity pair address.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether per-address sale limits apply.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to limit sales per address.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked +/- operators.
transferFrom subtracts _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
The unchecked balance and allowance updates occur inside transferFrom.
The unchecked arithmetic writes directly into the balanceOf mapping.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
_value is stored as the new allowance in approve().
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping in approve().
delegate() performs an arbitrary low-level delegatecall with caller supplied target and calldata.
Caller supplied address a is the delegatecall target.
Caller supplied bytes b is the delegatecall payload.
delegate() authorizes solely by requiring msg.sender == owner.
delegate() compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
The delegatecall executes untrusted code in this contract's context, which can re-enter transferFrom/transfer while state is mid-update.
Rates() is gated only by msg.sender being the owner or a hardcoded address.
Rates() checks msg.sender against the owner state variable.
spender selects which balance is overwritten in Rates().
addedValue directly determines the new balance written in Rates().
Rates() performs an unguarded arbitrary balance assignment.
Rates() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary value.
Rates() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a whitelist bypass.
Dismiss() requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
Dismiss() compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by Dismiss().
token is scaled by decimals and stored into _minSale.
maxToken is scaled by decimals and stored into _maxSale.
Dismiss() writes the _minSale state variable.
Dismiss() writes the _maxSale state variable.
Dismiss() writes the _saleNum state variable.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
batchSend() compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
_tos array controls the loop length and destinations in batchSend().
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited to each recipient.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and each balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
The unchecked multiplication and loop accumulation take place in batchSend().
The unchecked batch arithmetic writes into the balanceOf mapping.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend().
Local _to holds each destination address credited in batchSend().
AddLiquidity() writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable with no access control.
Caller supplied addr is blindly assigned to tradeAddress.
The unrestricted tradeAddress assignment is the body of AddLiquidity().
The unsafe assignment targets the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
A poisoned tradeAddress later causes ensure() to whitelist the attacker controlled address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants infinite allowance to the router in the allowance mapping.
msg.sender becomes the deployer with full initial supply and ownership.
pairFor() returns the derived pair address consumed by ensure().
Local _UNI holds the pair address checked against _from in ensure().
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure() reads owner as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to skip the condition() gate.
msg.sender flows through transferFrom into ensure() as the acting sender.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer().
_value is only meaningful as the amount argument of transfer().
_from is the source argument consumed by transferFrom().
_to is the recipient argument consumed by transferFrom().
_value is the amount argument consumed by transferFrom().
_spender is only used to index allowance inside approve().
_value is only used as the stored allowance in approve().
_from is the whitelist subject checked by ensure().
_value is forwarded by ensure() into condition().
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by Dismiss().
token is only converted into _minSale by Dismiss().
maxToken is only converted into _maxSale by Dismiss().
spender selects the balanceOf entry overwritten by Rates().
addedValue is the arbitrary value written into balanceOf through the unsafe Rates() assignment.
_tos drives the transfer loop in batchSend().
_value is the amount credited per recipient in batchSend().
addr is the value written directly into the tradeAddress whitelist.
address a becomes the target of the unsafe delegatecall.
bytes b becomes the untrusted calldata of the delegatecall.
Local _UNI is a temporary pair address used only inside ensure().
Loop counter i only controls iteration inside batchSend().
Local _to is a per-iteration alias of a batchSend() recipient.
